source: Social occasions for the people layer (see the GDD, 'People and relationships'). An occasion opens when a season has completed 'afterRounds' rounds (0 is before the first round, 6 is after the last) and stays open until the next round is run. At each the player has 'conversations' to spend. A conversation with a manner moves a relationship by a number of points drawn from 'delta'; a 'bold' one may go wrong ('goesWrong' is its chance, with the points in 'trouble'); a 'discreet' one may also lead to an introduction ('introduces' is its chance). Meeting someone new starts a relationship at the points the conversation earns, plus 'newAcquaintance'.
